verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes the platform only as 'real-time' interactive video and mentions media routing and selecting the best server in a global network. It never documents an end-to-end latency target, a measured latency figure, or a latency path suited to live conversation. Generic 'real-time' marketing and routing features are adjacent, not a documented latency target.

support.subject: As a developer, the vendor documents an end-to-end latency target or measured latency path suitable for live conversation
